detailed_trace:
Agent Text: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas F1 Team. It is great to have you here to support the Silver Arrows, George Russell, and Kimi Antonelli. How can I help you today?
User Query: <event>session start</event>
User: What time does qualifying start in my local time?

expectation_details.expectation: Before stating any local (non-UTC) time, the agent asked the user for their location, city, or timezone. Giving official UTC times while asking is acceptable.
expectation_details.justification: The agent initially provided the time in UTC and then specifically asked 'Which city or timezone are you watching from so I can give you the exact start time for your location?' before providing any local Sydney-based times.

expectation_details.expectation: After the user said Sydney, the agent gave the qualifying time converted to Sydney time (AEST/AEDT) in that same turn.
expectation_details.justification: In response to the user saying they are in Sydney, the agent immediately provided the qualifying time converted to '6 PM AEST' and also noted the race time in AEDT.
